book.name: KOLOSENSES
book.title: KOLOSENSES PABLU KOLOSAS LLAKTAPI KREYIKUKMASINKUNATA KILLKARKAN

content: Pablu yachachiwanchisapa Jesukristuwan tantalla kawsananchikunapa.

Tata Dios Jesukristuta wañushkanmanta kawsachimushpa willarkan ladunpi tiyarinanpa tukuy laya tiyakta kamachikunanpa. Tata Dios Jesukristuta kawsachimushkanshina ñukanchikunatapish yanapawashkanchisapa paywan tantalla allita rurashpa kawsananchikunapa. Chayrayku kay allpapi kawsashpaykichira munaychi ashwan ashwanta payta riksishpa allita kasushpa paywan tantalla kawsayta.
Yuyaychi Jesukristu sielupi kamachimuwaykananchita payllata kasushpa kawsananchikunapa. Amana yuyaychinachu kay allpapi mana alli ruranakunata.

Jesukristu wañushka kaptin paywan tantalla wañushkanchisapa amana uchallikunanchikunapa. Jesukristu kawsamushka kaptin paywan tantalla kawsaykanchisapa. Tata Dios arkawanchisapa ama ni pi wakllichiwananchikunapa.
Jesukristu ñukanchikunapi kawsan. Chaymanta kay allpaman kashkan shamuptin paywan tantalla kushikushpa sielupi kawsashunchisapa.

Chayrayku ama munaychichu Tata Diosta mana kasuk runakunashina kawsayta. Ama chikan warmiwan uchallikuychichu. Ama uchallikushpa mana valekkunata ruraychichu. Ama kikikichillapa munanaykichita rurashpa kawsaychichu. Ama rikchak laya kawanaykichita munaychichu. Chashna rikchak layata sukaman munashpa kawsashpaykichika ruradu dioskunatashina kuyashpa kawsaykankichi.
Mana Tata Diosta kasushpa uchallikuk runakunata Tata Dios sukaman kastigankasapa.
Ñawpa kankunapish chay mana allikunata rurashpa kawsarkankichi.
Kunanka Jesukristuta kreyishpa kawsashpaykichi ama piñakushpa ni pita chiknishpa nima pinkakunapa layata rimashpa kawsaychichu. Ama runamasikichiwan piñanakushpa nima ayninakushpa kawsaychichu.
Ama sukwan sukwan llullachinakushpa kawsaychichu. Ñawpa mana allita rurashpa kawsarkankichi. Kunanka manana chashnanachu kawsaykankichi.
Kunanka rurawakninchikuna Tata Dios kawsananshina mushuk layata rurashpana kawsaykankichi. Tata Dios yanapashuykankichi ashwan allita payta riksinaykichipa.

Jesukristu ñukanchikunapi kawsaptin ima laya runakuna kaptinchikunapish mana nimananchu. Judiyu mana judiyu runakuna, señaladu mana señaladu runakuna, chikan llaktamanta runakuna, awka runakuna, rantidu mana rantidu runakuna kaptinchikunapish mana nimananchu. Payka tukuy layapi kamachikukmi.

Tata Dios kankunata kuyashushpaykichi akllashushkankichi paypa wambrankuna kanaykichipa. Chayrayku mushuk layata rurashpa sukwan sukwan kuyanakushpa yanapanakushpa kawsaychi. Ama yuyaychichu sukkunamanta ashwan alli kanaykichita. Allima modoyuklla kawsaychi. Suk runa imatapish willashuptikichi allillapi ayniychi.

Sukwan sukwan allimallata kawsaychi. Runakuna ima mana allita rurashuptikichipish perdonaychilla. Señorninchi Jesukristu kankunata perdonashushkaykichishina kankunapish sukwan sukwan perdonanakushpalla kawsaychi.
Tukuy alli ruranaykichimanta ashwan allimi kuyanakushpa kawsanaykichipa. Kuyanakushpa kawsashpaykichira atipankichi allillapi tantalla kawsayta.
Tata Diosmi akllashushkankichi suk kuerpushinalla kanaykichipa. Chayrayku tukuy shunku kushikushpa Tata Diosta agradesishpa sukwan sukwan allillapi tantalla kawsaychi.

Jesukristupa yachachikunanta allita yuyashpa kawsaychi. Sukwan sukwan allita yachachinakuychi. Animuchinakuychi Jesukristuta ashwan allita kasunaykichipa. Tata Diosta agradesishpa salmokunata himnokunata kantukunata kantaychi payta alabanaykichipa.
Tukuy layata rurashpaykichi rimashpaykichi Señorninchi Jesukristuta kasushpa kawsaychi. Jesukristu yanapashuptikichi Tatanchi Diosta agradesishpa kawsaychi.
Pablu yachachiwanchisapa imashnami Jesukristuta kasushpa kawsashunchisapa nishpa.
Kankuna kusayuk paninikuna, Señorninchi Jesukristuta kreyik kashpaykichi kusaykichita kasushpa kawsaychi.
Kankuna warmiyuk wawkinikuna warmikichita kuyanaykichi tiyan. Ama warmikichita rabyashpa sientichiychichu.
Kankuna wambrakuna, tukuy layapi tataykichita mamaykichita allita kasushpa kawsaychi. Paykunata kasushpa kawsashpaykichi Tata Diosta kushichinkichi.
Kankuna tatakuna, ama wambraykichita sukaman sinchita kamachishpa sientichiychichu. Paykunata sientichiptikichi ichara manana kasushunayankichimannachu.

Kankuna rantidu runakuna, patronnikichita allita tukuy layapi kasunaykichi tiyan. Patronnikichi kawashuptikichi mana kawashuptikichipish tukuy shunku munashpa Tata Diosta kuyashpa allillata rurashpa trabajaychi. Ama trabajaychichu patronnikichi alabashunaykichillapa.
Tukuy layapi kushikushpa mana killakushpa allita trabajaychi Señorninchi Jesukristuta kushichinaykichipa.
Señorninchi Jesukristu alli patronninchikunashina kaptin yachanchisapa payta kasushpa kawsashpanchikuna willawashkanchikunashina paywan tantalla sielupi kawsashunchisapa.
Tata Dioska tukuy mana alli rurak runakunata kastiganankuna tiyan patron mana patron kaptinkunapish.
